subject: complete public decision payload rendered through registered JSON Forms
coverage: the default contract adapter registers one form per allowed Decision response
forms cover reason, condition refs and optional reauth proof from the public SubmitDecisionPayload
registered schemas are bounded and reject additional user fields

the server refetches the Decision with Strong consistency before accepting a form
submission revalidates Pending state, version, package digest and allowed response

form input is revalidated with Ajv 2020 after JSON parsing
rejection requires a reason and forbids condition refs
idempotency keys bind reason, condition refs and reauth proof together
accepted submissions are not rendered as externally effective
JSON Forms is lazily loaded outside the Decision first-load bundle
limits: production reviewer qualification and Domain governance assembly remain host work
browser E2E, keyboard, screen-reader and performance verification remain open
production identity adapter installation remains a host requirement
